findings.detail: Stored principal_amount is negative, but the source row's Principal cell is blank/dash while the negative parenthetical values are Cost and Fair Value.

rationale: Class 2 within-row check. The flagged holding is Skydio, Inc First Lien Delayed Draw Term Loan B. Source table 32 row 11 shows the Principal column as blank/dash, then Cost as (29,429) and Fair Value as (33,750). The pipeline observed principal_amount -3144.0, which is not supported by the raw Principal cell and appears localized to extraction of the wrong signed value into principal_amount.
